title: Settings screen: design review
summary: Three sections to approve before the settings screen of the demo app is built.

status.note: Three sections of the settings screen design.

body.p: The settings screen lets a signed-in user change their display name, notification e-mails and theme. Every change saves on its own, with a short "Saved" note next to the field.
Tabs across the top; each tab is one short form.

body.alt: Not chosen: tabs down the side

body.p: A failed save keeps the typed value, turns the field border red and shows "Couldn't save, retrying". With no notification rules yet, the tab shows one line and an "Add a rule" button.

items.title: How long should a changed e-mail stay unverified before the account is locked?

body.p: Sam's account keeps the old e-mail active until the new one is verified. Say the grace period.
